duration_diff_s.note: neural - stimulus (64 Hz lengths); stimulus track ends at the last sentence end

backward.method: LOTO (leave-one-Part-out) ridge backward decoder, 62 ch, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz, avg ref; nulls: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and the other Parts' envelopes (<= 3) per held-out trial (subject null: 2000 draws of one null value per trial; population: mean of the subject nulls); lag sweep +-1 s in 1-sample (15.6 ms) steps, parabolic peak, subject-bootstrap CI; subjects with one Part (HK044) have no decoder

latency_trf_fc.method: forward TRF of the envelope, 128 Hz, 1-15 Hz, FC mean (FZ CZ F3 F4 C3 C4), avg ref (62 ch); P1 = max 20-90 ms, N1 = min 70-200 ms (same code as herrmann2025)

weissbart2019_same_method_16ch.note: weissbart2019 standardised (stimtrack-aligned), restricted to herrmann2025's 16 scalp channels, average reference over them; same backward model / latency TRF code
